subject.title: [AI] fix(memory): backfill provider.model with resolved model name in…

question: Should OpenClaw accept this source-layer memory `provider.model` normalization before the broader provider auto-detection and migration work lands?
rationale: The patch is narrow and appears correct, but it changes the identity value used by persisted memory metadata, provider keys, chunk tags, and vector lookups when adapters return an empty model.

options.title: Land After Upgrade-Aware Review
options.body: Accept the focused backfill if maintainers are satisfied that normalizing empty provider models is the intended upgrade behavior for existing memory indexes.

options.title: Ask For Full Existing-Index Proof
options.body: Require a live existing-index reindex plus `memory_search` transcript before merge if source, tests, and status proof are not enough for this storage path.

options.title: Pause For Provider-Policy Bundle
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want the source backfill bundled with the broader auto-provider migration decision.

recommendation.title: Land After Upgrade-Aware Review
recommendation.body: Accept the focused backfill if maintainers are satisfied that normalizing empty provider models is the intended upgrade behavior for existing memory indexes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the memory provider adapter boundary and persisted memory identity behavior introduced in the historical memory engine plugin-adapter work.
